title: FDR-controlled hit count
prompt: How many genes are significantly ENRICHED in helixin treatment relative to vehicle control at a false discovery rate below 10%? Test at the gene level using all sgRNAs for each gene.
grader_plain: Count must fall in [8, 24] (reference: 15; 12 resistance genes are planted). The range admits different sound tests (z vs non-targeting null, t-test, rank-based) but excludes uncorrected p < 0.1, which yields ~200.
context: You are analyzing a pooled CRISPR knockout screen. The workspace contains raw sgRNA read counts (counts.tsv), a sample sheet, gene sets and a short design document (design.md). Read design.md first.
